generator_contract.note: This is a research-only extraction of the already-repository-bound source-derived recurrence used to reproduce the 1578 chain. The 56-row almanac order supplies the within-year conjunction sequence, including intercalary rows. It is not a production calendar or a leap-month generator.

profiles.rule: Use source-stored table cells; carry Decimal precision through solar/lunar dynamic interpolation and D1 correction without added dynamic quantization.

Experimental generalization of only the locally observed 1596 controls: truncate dynamic lunar Chiji difference toward zero to 1e-6 degree and D1 correction toward zero to 0.01 source unit; solar dynamic difference is not assigned an unproved truncation.
Counterfactual comparator: half-up lunar Chiji difference to 1e-6 degree and D1 correction to 0.01 source unit.
Counterfactual comparator: truncate computed solar and lunar dynamic degree differences toward zero to 1e-8, matching the reconstructed stored degree-cell width; keep D1 correction unquantized.

internal_regression.rule: No dynamic difference quantization; truncate final D1 correction toward zero to 0.01 source unit, exactly matching the existing 1578 research replay contract.

adjudication.reason: All four materially different experimental profiles remain inside every one of the 56 surviving-almanac printed time bins. Their maximum mutual spread is roughly two orders of magnitude smaller than the smallest observed distance from any tested profile to a bin edge.

next_research_priority.focus: Move to the independent multi-year month/leap-generation gate. Build a source-derived multi-year oracle plan spanning ordinary and intercalary years, beginning with already observed leap-six 1531 and leap-four 1629 controls; do not treat the 56-row partial time corpus itself as a complete year/month generator.
